simple.summary: גִּתִּית (Gittîyth) means a Gittite harp First listed occurrence: Ps 8 1.

definitions.full: H1665. Gittith גִּתִּית feminine of foregoing (si vera lectio) only in phrase עַלהַֿגִּתִּית in three Psalm titles: Psa 8:1 ; 81:1 ; 84:1 ; upon the Gittite ( lyre ) so ᵑ7 , to the Gittite ( melody ) Ew Ol De, or either of these Hup Pe; הַגִּתֹּת ᵑ9 ᵐ5 wine-presses , whence Bae and others at the wine-presses , i.e. (Bae) a song for the feast of booths.
